title: Action copy takes two hole syntaxes: description, param helpText and outcomeMessages read ${…}, confirmText and successMessage read {{ … }}
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Ruled: 6545229148 · letter A · 2026-10-31T15:15Z

domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27434 said: triage rows 1–7, TAKE what is ui-only, CARD the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` `e41642dd` (report 6515174308, `out_of_scope_findings`).
Reach: any action whose copy carries a record or result hole. HotCRM knowledge article feedback actions (`outcomeMessages`), and `send_email` / `log_call` (`description`, param `helpText`).
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first (one template slot, or a lint rule), then `domain:ui` (`ActionRunner` fill).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "outcomeMessages successMessage hole syntax double brace dollar brace description helpText" → #24814 (closed; it typed `confirmText` / `successMessage` as template slots), nothing open.

## Observed
- `confirmText` and `successMessage` are ADR-0032 template slots: `{{ … }}` holes, and the publish gate refuses `${…}`.
- `outcomeMessages` is filled by `substituteScopeTokens` (`${result.x}` holes, `composeSuccessMessage`).
- The param dialog's `description` and each param's `helpText` are filled through the runner's evaluator (`${record.x}`, `templateEvaluatorFor`).
- The spec tells an author whose action has params to move the confirm question from `confirmText` onto `description`. There the same `{{ record.x }}` hole prints raw. The thread measured this through the runner from both the header door and the row door; `${record.x}` is filled on both since objectui#12967. This is #27434 row 1's residual: its premise (no row reaches the dialog) is disproved on `main`.
- No lint rule names the wrong hole on any of these keys.

## Wanted
All five keys as one template slot: the spec describe, the publish refusal, the ui runner fill, and a migration for existing `${…}` copy. At minimum, a lint rule naming the wrong hole on each key. The ui half follows as a `domain:ui` card once the spec decides the syntax.

Dedupe words: outcomeMessages hole syntax, description helpText template holes, double brace vs dollar brace action copy, successMessage outcomeMessages interpolation.

Related: #27434 (rows 7 and 1), #24814.
